entity.name: Antonio Leandro
entity.description: Software engineer in Recife, Brazil. Author and sole maintainer of OmniGet.

projects.name: OmniGet
projects.description: A free desktop downloader for Windows, macOS and Linux: paste a link from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, Reddit, Twitch or one of the sites yt-dlp supports and get the file. Its MCP server lets Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code queue downloads, and it runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and local models as AI agents in a window. No account, no ads, no telemetry on what anyone downloads. Files stay on the machine that fetched them.

channels.description: Bank transfer for grants and invoiced sponsorships. Details on request.

plans.name: A year of maintenance
plans.description: What it costs to keep OmniGet alive for twelve months: builds and code signing across three platforms, plus the constant repair of extractors as the sites they read change underneath them. One person does all of it.

plans.name: In-app sponsor
plans.description: Your logo on the About screen of the app itself, bundled with the binary so the page never calls home. Unlike a README, this is seen again every time someone opens the app, and no other project in this category sells it.

plans.name: README sponsor
plans.description: Your logo in the README, above the fold, in a repository with over 14,000 GitHub stars. For comparison, CodeRabbit pays ESLint $1,000 a month for the same kind of placement.
